title: Visual Orientalism in the AI Era: From West-East Binaries to English-Language Centrism
reasoning: The paper investigates geopolitical and cultural representation bias (Visual Orientalism) in AI image generation. While it utilizes religious symbols and architecture as indicators of 'cultural exoticization' versus 'political representation,' it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core component of the research.
